title: Self-Repulsive Sampling for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39560v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sampling several responses and voting over their answers can improve a language model's accuracy, but repeated answers limit the benefit of additional samples. Raising temperature increases diversity at a potential cost to per-sample accuracy. We introduce Self-Repulsion (SR), a sampler for masked diffusion language models that uses peer commitments to diversify the pool. At each penalized denoising step, each path lowers a token's logit according to how many peers have committed that token at the same position. Paths share a batched forward pass and then commit in sequence, so later paths observe choices made earlier in the same step. This coupling requires no training or additional forward or backward pass and can produce distinct paths even at temperature zero. translated_title: 扩散语言模型的自排斥采样
translated_abstract: 对多个响应进行采样并对其答案进行投票可以提升语言模型的准确率，但重复的答案限制了额外样本带来的收益。提高温度虽能增加多样性，却可能以牺牲单样本的准确率为代价。我们提出了自排斥，这是一种面向掩码扩散语言模型的采样器，它利用同伴路径的提交结果来使样本池多样化。在每一个带惩罚的去噪步骤中，每条路径会根据已有多少同伴路径在同一位置提交了某个词元来降低该词元的logit值。各路径共享一次批处理前向传播，然后依次提交，因此后面的路径能够观察到同一时间步内先前路径所做的选择。这种耦合机制无需任何训练，也无需额外的前向或反向传播，即使在温度为零的情况下也能产生彼此不同的路径。当所有路径基于相同的logit值共同提交某个位置时，该更新恰好使总logit减去一个凸重复成本后的目标达到最大。在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上使用十条路径的实验（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的自排斥（SR）采样器，通过让并行的去噪路径根据同伴路径的提交结果对重复词元进行惩罚来增加样本多样性，即使在零温度下也能产生多样化的路径，从而提升扩散语言模型投票式推理的准确率。
en_tdlr: Self-Repulsion (SR) is a training-free sampler for masked diffusion language models that lowers the logits of tokens already committed by peer paths, yielding diverse sample pools—even at temperature zero—to improve voting-based accuracy.
